headlines.title: Earnings Preview: Mondelez (MDLZ) Q3 Earnings Expected to Decline
headlines.summary: Mondelez (MDLZ) doesn't possess the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely earnings beat in its upcoming report. Get prepared with the key expectations.

headlines.title: Mondelēz launches gluten-free Ritz crackers
headlines.summary: The snack giant has previously released gluten-free versions of Oreo and Chips Ahoy! as brands look for growth by catering to a range of dietary needs.

headlines.title: Should Brand Tie Ups Require Action From Mondelez International (MDLZ) Investors?
headlines.summary: Mondelez International is leaning into brand partnerships and product extensions, from RITZ Gluten Free Crackers to SOUR PATCH KIDS and OREO themed limited time offers through partners such as Wingstop and Portillo’s. The business is seeing renewed consumer appetite for its Americana cookie portfolio, with nostalgia driven demand adding to the momentum in its core snacking franchises.

headlines.title: Mondelez (MDLZ) Stock Looks Cheap Against Future Cash Flow
headlines.summary: Mondelez International has delivered a 20.2% total return over the past 5 years, and the share price now raises a simple question for investors. Is the current US$63.34 level adequately backed by the cash flows the business is expected to generate over time, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying numbers? The 20.2% 5 year return places real focus on whether Mondelez International's recent share price level can be explained by its cash flow profile.

headlines.title: What Is Mondelez International (MDLZ) Signaling With Its Restaurant Menu Partnerships?
headlines.summary: Mondelez International (NasdaqGS:MDLZ) partnered its SOUR PATCH KIDS brand with Wingstop for limited-time flavored menu items in 2026. OREO from Mondelez International collaborated with Portillo’s to create time limited desserts that feature the biscuit brand in-store. These collaborations connect Mondelez snack labels with large restaurant traffic, widening exposure beyond traditional retail shelves.

description: Mondelez International, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and sells snack food and beverage products in Latin America, North America, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Europe. The company provides biscuits and baked snacks, including cookies, crackers, salted snacks, snack bars, and cakes and pastries; chocolates; and gums and candies, as well as various cheese, grocery, and powdered beverage products. Its brand portfolio includes Oreo, Ritz, LU, CLIF Bar, Tate's Bake Shop biscuits and baked snacks, Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka, and Toblerone chocolate. It serves supermarket chains, wholesalers, supercenters, club stores, mass merchandisers, distributors, convenience stores, gasoline stations, drug stores, value stores, and other retail food outlets through direct store delivery, company-owned and satellite warehouses, distribution centers, third-party distributors, and other facilities, as well as through independent sales offices and agents. The company also sells products directly to businesses and consumers through e-retail platforms, retailer digital platforms, as well as through its direct-to-consumer websites and social media platforms. Mondelez International, Inc. was formerly known as Kraft Foods Inc. and changed its name to Mondelez International, Inc. in October 2012. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
